name: Random User Generator
tagline: Free fake user profiles for demos, mocks, and testing
description: Public API that returns randomly generated user profiles with names, photos, addresses, and contact details. Widely used as placeholder people data for demos, UI mockups, and test fixtures. No authentication required for basic use.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints.

use_cases: generate fake user profiles for UI demos
seed mock people data for tests
